snippet.title: The Greedy Knight Steam Trailer
snippet.description:
a snack-sized auto-battler roguelite. a greedy knight and his unreliable party fight entirely on their own; you pick the dungeon, draft their upgrades and decide what the gold is for. a dungeon takes about two minutes. you'll die. you'll get richer.

The Greedy Knight  

Play the demo now!
